items.content:
America’s demographic tailwind is fading.

Growth in the 25-64 population:
1980s: 1.8% per year
1990s: 1.1% per year
Next decade: 0.3% per year

And that assumes immigration rebounds.

Future economic growth will increasingly depend on productivity gains.
